claims: The Dallas Wings selected UConn guard Azzi Fudd with the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The 2026 WNBA Draft featured expansion teams Toronto Tempo and Portland Fire.
UCLA set a record by having five players selected in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Minnesota Lynx (via Chicago) selected Olivia Miles (TCU) as the No. 2 pick in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Seattle Storm (via LA Sparks) selected Awa Fam Thiam (Spain) as the No. 3 pick in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Washington Mystics selected Lauren Betts (UCLA) as the No. 4 pick in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Chicago Sky (via Connecticut) selected Gabriela Jaquez (UCLA) as the No. 5 pick in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Toronto Tempo selected Kiki Rice (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Portland Fire selected Iyana Martín Carrión (Perfumerias Avenida) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Golden State Valkyries selected Flau'jae Johnson (LSU - traded to Seattle) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Washington Mystics (via Seattle) selected Angela Dugalić (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Indiana Fever selected Raven Johnson (South Carolina) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Washington Mystics (via NY Liberty) selected Cotie McMahon (Ole Miss) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Connecticut Sun (via Phoenix) selected Nell Angloma (Lattes Montpellier) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Atlanta Dream selected Madina Okot (South Carolina) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Seattle Storm (via Las Vegas) selected Taina Mair (Duke) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
The Connecticut Sun (via Minnesota) selected Gianna Kneepkens (UCLA) in the first round of the 2026 WNBA Draft.
Toronto Tempo and Portland Fire made their inaugural draft picks.
